background: ANZ is one of Australia's big four banks, with the largest presence of the four across New Zealand and Asia, funded by Australian and New Zealand deposits and wholesale markets and lending mainly on mortgages and to businesses.
synthesis: The agencies are aligned at a high level: AA- from Fitch and S&P and Aa2 from Moody's, all stable, with Fitch's upgrade to AA- on 26 May 2024 the latest move. Against Australian peers capital is mixed: CET1 of 12.5% is in the top quarter, but leverage of 4.5% is in the bottom quarter against the peer median. Liquidity is the weaker side, with LCR of 131% in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 113% below the peer median. CET1 has risen 0.6 points since 30 Jun 2025 and the rest has been flat. Nothing flagged in the last 90 days.
